target_customer: Consumer brands (CPG, DTC, food and beverage, beauty, fashion) with meaningful revenue, such as a large snack brand, that want automated analysis of their sales and marketing data.
problem: Consumer brands hold data across many sources but lack analysts to continuously find revenue opportunities, cost leaks, trends and anomalies.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for an AI analyst connected to a brand's data sources
product_category: AI data analyst for consumer brands

founders.name: Qasim Munye
education: King's College London, medical degree (per YC page, finishing while building ShortlyAI)
previous_startups: ShortlyAI (acquired by Jasper in 2021, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes ShortlyAI as one of the first commercial LLM applications.

founders.name: Mariam Ahmed
education: King's College London, Computer Science (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a King's prize and Forbes 30 Under 30 (2025); these are company claims.

exit.reason: Company website states only that Menza has been acquired and that the full story will be shared soon.

competitors.name: Triple Whale
competitors.what: Analytics and attribution dashboards for ecommerce brands
competitors.traction_then: Named by launch coverage as a rival; no figures found

competitors.name: Optimove
competitors.what: Customer data and marketing automation platform
competitors.traction_then: Named by launch coverage as a rival; no figures found

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting many brand data sources and running LLM agents over them is standard engineering with hard parts in integrations and reliability; founders had LLM product experience.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations help retention, but many AI analyst entrants and incumbents' dashboards can copy the idea.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Company website now states Menza was acquired; the acquirer and date are not public in sources found.

market_need_then: Brands pay for dashboards and analysts; LLMs made automated insight feasible in 2025. The company claims 100 percent retention and strong MRR growth, which are unverified own claims.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product language about a 24/7 analyst

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found; name is also used by unrelated businesses such as a coffee brand.

outcome_analysis: Menza launched in the Winter 2026 batch as an AI analyst for consumer brands and, by November 2026, its own website says it has been acquired, though the buyer, date and price are not public. YC lists it as Active, so the directory is out of date. The quick exit suggests an acquirer valued the team and product early, but the cause and terms cannot be determined from sources found.
notes: Funding sources conflict: one launch article reports $1.5M seed (page now suspended), one aggregator $500K, one $3M, one $2M over four rounds. None confirmed by a primary source, so no rounds recorded. YC directory status is Active while the company site says acquired; exit recorded as acquisition from the company's own statement. Competitors come from undated launch coverage. Completeness pass: two rounds recorded, each from a single source: a 1.5M seed from a launch article (Villpress, undated, page since suspended) and a 500K pre-seed dated 2023-09 from VCBacked, which may be the same funding or earlier ones (one source gives an S23 batch under the name Latentspace). Amounts are not summed.
